Steps.Text: Welcome duelist. I am Bob. I climbed this tower once, and lived. Let me show you one round of it.
And that is what is in the way.
You. DMG is how hard your hits start out.  AP determines how much you can do.  Vitae I'll cover later.  Last is your life, drop to zero and you're done ascending.
Your dealt hand. Click that one to queue it.
That Jab cost 1 AP. You may play five cards a round, but never more AP than you have.
Now look closer. Select all the same color cards. Cards that match make a hand, and a hand multiplies the whole blow - so take the other three.
Elemental Four of a Kind. Matching colours count, not just matching cards.
Now your hand calculates.  Each attack multiplies your DMG and your hand has its own multiplier.
Dead in one blow. Its vitae is yours, the only coin in this tower.
Every enemy has parasites you can use.
Choose a worm to change your deck.
Now your jewelry.  You won't survive without them.  Spend your vitae wisely.
Now proceed into the next room.
Go ahead, duelist, it's time to climb.
